title: Frames and Reality
coreMove: translate a framed choice into its equivalent wording before deciding
sourcePressure: shows that wording and framing change decisions even when the underlying outcomes stay the same
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: treating framing as mere spin rather than equivalent realities feeling different

hook: opening with a named bias definition for Frames and Reality
starting in a lecture hall or generic seminar
counterintuition: the obvious advice is simply slow down
smart people are immune if they know the term
tryThisNow: write three lessons in a journal
examples: student in a classroom guessing an answer
